intent: I continue with immaculate corporate reassurance while introducing stronger compliance terms. Registered devices will be used to verify occupied structures, delivery sites may be entered without additional consent, and interference with authorized units may cause a household to lose priority status. Keep location services enabled and do not conceal symptomatic residents. Every instruction is framed as convenience, continuity, and care, as though obedience itself were the product Gravitas is delivering.
emotion: polished corporate reassurance with controlled authority
